title: The Reddit Playbook for Winning AI Search
description:
SEO isn’t dead. AI just added a new layer.

Technical SEO, internal linking, and the fundamentals still matter. But now you also need to think about how AI agents discover, access, and recommend your business.

The companies that start optimizing for this now will have a head start as AI search grows.

Comment “NEWSLETTER” and I’ll send you more insights on AI, business, and marketing.
transcript: no different than SEO back in the early days where you you have good technical SEOs while you have good internal linking as well. This is the new way of doing this, right? And it layers on on top of the foundational traditional ways of doing SEO. I don't think those ways are dead necessarily because still a lot of the internet is still based built built off of those rails. So, what is this moving towards? We're talking about machine native memory and we're talking about recommendation layers that they're creating on their own. Am I saying that I'm guaranteeing that you're going to rank number one from this? No, but I am guaranteeing that if you don't do this starting now and your competitors start to do it, they're going to have more of an advantage over you do. If you start doing it now, you're going to have way more of an of a head start versus them and you're going to have a much easier time ranking number one from an AI agent's standpoint, from AI search standpoint.
